title: Barbara Palvin stuns on Victoria’s Secret runway six weeks after giving birth
summary: Barbara Palvin made her Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show comeback just six weeks after welcoming her first child, while husband Dylan Sprouse proudly cheered her on from the front row.
